project.name: AI Data Assistant
project.descriptor: An intelligent conversational data analytics platform for non-technical and technical users to connect data sources, ask questions, and receive analytical answers.

guardrails.statement: The system must encrypt data connections to SQL Server.

requirements.statement: The system must allow users to connect to SQL Server databases using secure connection settings.
The system must allow users to upload and analyze CSV files.
The system must provide a conversational interface for users to ask questions in natural language.
The system must interpret user questions and suggest potential interpretations if uncertain.
The system must analyze data to provide accurate, explainable answers to user questions.
The system must allow users to generate visualizations of analytical results with configurable parameters.
The system must generate reports based on analytical results.
The system must allow users to ask follow-up questions without repeating previous context.
The system must support user roles including Business Users, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and Executives.
The system must provide business-friendly explanations for analytical results.
The system must allow Data Analysts to generate SQL queries from natural language questions.
The system must allow Data Engineers to inspect schemas and profile data.
The system must provide executive summaries and KPIs for Executives.
The system must connect to SQL Server using Windows/Integrated Authentication and SQL Authentication.
The system must encrypt data connections to SQL Server.
The system must detect and handle null values and duplicate records in CSV uploads.
The system must provide alerts and recommendations based on data analysis.
The system must allow users to download reports and dashboards.

stories.title: Establish Initial Data Connection and Query Execution
stories.narrative: As a Data Analyst, I want to connect to a SQL Server database and execute an initial query so that I can begin working with real data.

stories.title: Upload and Analyze CSV Files
stories.narrative: As a Data Analyst, I want to upload a CSV file and have it analyzed so that I can work with data outside of a database.

stories.title: Ask Questions in Natural Language
stories.narrative: As a business user, I want to ask questions about my data in natural language so that I don't need to know SQL.

stories.title: Visualize Analytical Results
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to generate visualizations of analytical results with configurable parameters so that I can see patterns in the data.

stories.title: Provide Business-Friendly Explanations
stories.narrative: As a business user, I want analytical results explained in plain language so that I can understand them without technical background.

stories.title: Interpret User Questions and Suggest Interpretations
stories.narrative: As a User, I want the system to suggest interpretations of my question when it's uncertain so that I get the answer I actually meant.

stories.title: Analyze Data and Provide Explainable Answers
stories.narrative: As a User, I want the system to analyze data and explain how it reached its answer so that I can trust the result.

stories.title: Generate Reports from Analytical Results
stories.narrative: As a Data Analyst, I want to generate a report from analytical results so that I can share findings with others.

stories.title: Allow Follow-Up Questions
stories.narrative: As a business user, I want to ask follow-up questions without repeating context so that the conversation feels natural.

stories.title: Provide Executive Summaries and KPIs
stories.narrative: As a User, I want a summary of KPIs from the data so that I can make decisions quickly.

stories.title: Inspect Schemas and Profile Data
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want to inspect schemas and profile data so that I can assess data quality before it's used.

stories.title: Support Multiple User Roles
stories.narrative: As an admin, I want to assign roles including Business User, Data Analyst, Data Engineer, and Executive so that access matches responsibility.

stories.title: Secure Data Connections
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want data connections to SQL Server encrypted so that data in transit is protected.

stories.title: Provide Alerts and Recommendations
stories.narrative: As a business user, I want alerts and recommendations based on data analysis so that I can act on important changes.
